description.value: Overlay (midi-qol): the Monster Manual's Ooze Cube (Gelatinous Cube): it fills its space, and creatures move through each other's spaces (the Passable status, one of dnd5e's statuses that never block movement); its Engulf overlay asks, for each creature whose space its move enters, whether it engulfs it. Not covered yet: its room (one Large or four Medium creatures), a creature entering its space (subjected to Engulf, with Disadvantage), pulling a creature out.

effects.name: Passable
effects.description: Other creatures' spaces don't stop this creature's movement, and its space doesn't stop theirs.
